info.name: HustleHub - Gigs
info.description:
Security and functional tests for HustleHub+ (Part 2): auth, gigs, bookings, transactions, income, admin access, input sanitisation, security headers and rate limiting. Run top to bottom.

Before running: execute `npm run seed:admin` and copy ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD into the adminEmail / adminPassword collection variables (Current value only - do not commit them). Admin tests are skipped if these are empty.

Folder 11 deliberately trips the rate limiters. Afterwards, failed logins from your IP are blocked for 15 minutes, so wait (or restart the server) before running the collection again.

item.name: 10.2 Rate limit headers use the standard format
11 - Rate Limiting
item.description: Run last. These requests intentionally exhaust the limiters. The booking limiter is per user, so it only blocks this run's client. The auth limiter is per IP and blocks all logins from this machine for 15 minutes.

item.name: 11.1 Booking limiter blocks a client after 20 attempts

exec: pm.sendRequest({ url: `${baseUrl}/bookings`, method: "POST", header: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: `Bearer ${pm.collectionVariables.get("tokenClient")}` }, body: { mode: "raw", raw: "{}" } }, (err, res) => {
if (err) return pm.test("Request sent", () => { throw err; });
console.log(`${attempts} extra request(s) needed to hit the limit`);

request.description: Sends empty booking bodies. The limiter runs before validation, so these 400s still count towards the limit without creating any bookings.

item.name: 11.2 Freelancer bookings unaffected by client limit

request.description: The booking limiter is keyed on the user id, so one client hitting the limit does not block other users.

item.name: 11.3 Auth limiter blocks repeated failed logins

exec: pm.sendRequest({ url: `${baseUrl}/auth/login`, method: "POST", header: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: { mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify({ email: `freelancerA${pm.collectionVariables.get("runId")}@test.com`, password: "WrongPassw0rd!" }) } }, (err, res) => {
if (err) return pm.test("Request sent", () => { throw err; });
console.log(`${attempts} extra request(s) needed to hit the limit`);

request.description: Brute-force protection: after 10 failed logins in 15 minutes the IP gets 429. Successful logins are not counted (skipSuccessfulRequests).

item.name: 11.4 Correct password also blocked while limited (429)

request.description: Once the limit is hit, the attacker cannot keep guessing even if the next guess would be correct.
